title: Robust Risk-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning from Corrupted Human Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2609.38938v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF) learns from human comparisons, which can be corrupted or deliberately manipulated. This paper studies online risk-sensitive RLHF with static conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) under adversarial preference-label flips. We consider additive linear rewards and a fixed-reference protocol with one comparison per episode and at most $C$ flipped labels over $K$ episodes. We propose weighted streamed-preference CVaR RLHF (WSP-CVaR-RLHF), which combines uncertainty-weighted reward estimation with optimistic augmented-state CVaR planning. For known transitions and normalized rewards, we establish the regret bound $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{d}{\kappa}\sqrt{\frac{K}{\alpha}}+\frac{dC}{\kappa\alpha}\right)$ up to lower-order terms, where $d$ is the reward-feature dimension, $\alpha$ is the CVaR level, and $\kappa$ characterizes the preference link. translated_title: 基于受损人类反馈的鲁棒风险敏感强化学习
translated_abstract: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）从人类的比较判断中学习，而这些比较可能被破坏或被故意操纵。本文研究了在对抗性偏好标签翻转下，采用静态条件风险价值（CVaR）的在线风险敏感RLHF问题。我们考虑加性线性奖励以及固定参照协议，即每个回合进行一次比较，且在K个回合中至多有C个标签被翻转。我们提出了加权流式偏好CVaR RLHF（WSP-CVaR-RLHF）算法，该算法将不确定性加权的奖励估计与基于乐观原则的增广状态CVaR规划相结合。对于转移已知且奖励已归一化的情形，我们建立了遗憾界 $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{d}{\kappa}\sqrt{\frac{K}{\alpha}}+\frac{dC}{\kappa\alpha}\right)$（精确到低阶项），其中 $d$ 为奖励特征维度，$\alpha$ 为CVaR水平，$\kappa$ 刻画偏好链接函数的特性。该遗憾界将干净数据下的统计代价与污染数据带来的代价分离开来。
tldr: 本文提出WSP-CVaR-RLHF算法，通过不确定性加权奖励估计与增广状态CVaR规划相结合，在人类偏好标签遭受对抗性翻转污染的情况下实现鲁棒的风险敏感RLHF，并给出了将干净统计代价与污染代价分离的遗憾界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes WSP-CVaR-RLHF, which combines uncertainty-weighted reward estimation with optimistic augmented-state CVaR planning to achieve robust risk-sensitive RLHF under adversarial preference-label flips, establishing a regret bound that separates the clean statistical cost from the corruption cost.
